name: Pennsylvania
overview: Pennsylvania's refundable Property Tax/Rent Rebate covers older adults, qualifying widows and widowers, and adults with disabilities.

programs.name: Property Tax/Rent Rebate
programs.ageRule: 65 or older (including qualifying spouse); widow or widower 50 or older; permanently disabled adult 18 or older.
programs.incomeDefinition: Program household income includes spouse's income and excludes half of Social Security, SSI, State Supplementary Payments and Railroad Retirement Tier 1.
programs.maximumBenefit: Standard rebate up to $1,000; eligible homeowners may receive up to $1,500 including supplement.
programs.formulaSummary: Income bands set standard rebates of $1,000, $770, $460, or $380, limited by property taxes paid or 20% of rent. Supplemental homeowner rebates depend on income, locality, or tax-to-income burden.
programs.application: File PA-1000 or use myPATH in 2026 for 2025 taxes or rent.
eligibilityNotes: Principal residence; paid taxes or rent.
Rental property must be taxable or subject to payments in lieu of taxes.
Public assistance can limit qualifying rental months.
interactions: Owner/renter claims share one annual rebate cap; supplement calculated by Revenue.
programs.programYear: 2025 property taxes or rent and household income; rebate claim filed in 2026.
